BI have some wonderful news for you! Doctor Gregory Victor, chief physician of Horde Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Hammerfall. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great Doctor Gregory Victor! Do not squander this opportunity!
completion: Wonderful. Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!

6983.name: You're a Mean One...
desc: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
details: A c-c-creature called "The Abominable Greench" is the one w-w-who stole our shipment of t-t-treats, $N. Be c-c-careful though! He is t-t-the one who turned me into this s-s-snowy mess!

BYou're g-g-gonna need some help in f-f-facing him. I've seen him w-w-wander all around where the y-y-yeti are; he's s-s-surely here s-s-somewhere! F-f-find the treats $N, take them b-b-back to Smokywood Pastures in Orgrimmar, and t-t-tell them I n-n-need to be unfrozen!
completion: You found it! You've saved Smokywood Pasture's Feast of Winter Veil!

BPoor Sacks... we'll be sure to send a team out there and figure out a way to unfreeze him. Hopefully, he'll be back in time for the day of the Feast; he'll need to make up missed time working though. Still, this wouldn't even be possible if it weren't for you!

7223.name: Armor Scraps
desc: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.
objectives: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.
details: Battles rage constantly in Alterac Valley, and the supplies we get from Ironforge are not enough to outfit our experienced troops.
BIf you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!
completion: These are some good pieces, $N. I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.
BIf my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!

7367.name: Defusing the Threat
desc: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
objectives: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
details: The Frostwolf have their front lines and bases booby trapped, $c. You have to watch your step when invading enemy territory.

BIf you want to make a solid strike against them, you must destroy their source of anti personnel munitions - I'm talking about their explosives expert. If you kill him, you are safe to disarm the mines. As long as he is kept down, the mines will also stay down.
BYou will probably find him in a tower near the Iceblood Garrison. Good luck!
completion: NULL

7463.name: Arcane Refreshment
desc: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.
objectives: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.
details: A $r mage! How wonderous. I have not seen one of your kind for... oh what is it going on now? 500 years!
BI have something that will quench your thirst, but first you must do a task for me.
B<Lydros snickers.>
BThere is an anomaly in Eldre'Thalas. A water elemental has taken residence in the east wing. His presence must be catalogued!
BVenture to the Warpwood Quarter and extract a portion of the elemental essence of the Hydrospawn. Return it to me and I shall teach you a useful cantrip.
completion: Wonderful! Who are you again? Oh it matters not. What was I supposed to give you? Hrm... well you are a $C, perhaps you will find this useful.

7583.name: Suppression
desc: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.
objectives: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
BUse the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
BShould you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.
details: The prison is ready. Now for the most difficult portion of this task.
BYou must find and capture a Doomguard Commander within the Tainted Scar using this crystal prison.
BBe warned! A Doomguard is a cunning and lethal adversary and will seek to destroy you as you begin the ritual of imprisonment. It will flail wildly in its attempts to escape imprisonment.
BIt will focus on nothing but you, $N. Because of this, I must recommend that you take companions capable of keeping you alive!
completion: You have done as I have asked. You are ready to be given the knowledge to conjure and control the beast.

7631.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
desc: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.
objectives: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.
details: All the preparations are made. Now, you must perform the ritual to create a Circle of Greater Summoning, then use the parchment infused with Xorothian stardust... to open a portal to Xoroth.
BI have written the instructions for the ritual onto a scroll. Study it closely, for you must perform each step exactly if you wish to succeed.
BFortune to you, $N. And may the souls of your enemies swiftly find their way into your shard pouch.
completion: The Xorothian Dreadsteed's spirit is beaten. Although rage pulses through its ghostly flanks, you know that the beast's soul is yours...
BIt whispers dark magic into your mind and instills within you the knowledge to summon a dreadsteed.

7655.name: Imperial Plate Bracer
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya.
BAnd $N, wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

7703.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
desc: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
objectives: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
BAccording to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
details: Now you da king, so maybe you get prized Gordok artifact back from creepy elf who calls himself Prince! Da king before you failed, just like all da other kings since Tortheldrin - da creepy elf - stole it from old timey Gordok king!

BArtifact is called da Gauntlet of Gordok Might. Old timey stories say only da one true king da Gordok can get it back. Old timey story also say creepy elf is still around here - you find it and it will become mighty gauntlet you wear forever! Yar, I show you!
completion: Wow... you ARE da true $gking:queen;! I never think I see this gauntlet in my life! It look like it got no mojo left anymore... maybe that creepy elf try and ruin gauntlet. Well, I say HAR HAR to him!

BLook - this mark on da gauntlet an old old OLD timey magic mark, older than da Gordok they say. Well, as Captain of da Gordok, we all learn one thing over and over - how to make mark come to life and give power back to gauntlet!
BI do it for you, $gking:queen;! Here, take da gauntlet and rule FOREVER!

7727.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
desc: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.
objectives: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
BYou will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
BReturn to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.
details: Bunions, $g lad:lass;. Me bunions got bunions. How am I supposed to do any sort of killin' with me feet in such disarray? That's why ye're gonna help.

BScrange and Burninate tasked me to kill these things so they can send some expeditionary teams down into the Slag Pit lava pools to do some explorin'. Supposedly some incendosaurs or some such nonsense down there causin' all kinds o' problems. Now move along an' don't come back 'til the incendosaur population be extinct.
completion: Oh me achin' feets.
BI figured since ye didn't have a luffa...

7799.name: A Donation of Mageweave
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7823.name: A Donation of Runecloth
completion: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

7847.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
desc: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
objectives: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
details: Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Tell her that I am coming home! She is sure to reward you.
completion: You have done the Revantusk a great service, $N! We owe you a great debt of gratitude.

7871.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
details: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young $c. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war.
BEnter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces!
BDo this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, $N, and I shall reward you.
completion: NULL

8063.name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers
desc: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence. A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered. We would not be here today without them.
BBring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors. Embrace the madness!
completion: Well done, $N... your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub have earned you the right to call the Zandalar tribe as a friend. I will see to the disposition of the Paragons; for your effort please accept this reward!

8111.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
completion: The neck piece not be for smokin', mon! You got to use it to fight evil.

8183.name: The Heart of Hakkar
desc: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.
objectives: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.
details: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within. Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
completion: Ah, the Heart of Hakkar. So the Soulflayer has been slain! Our world is saved!
B$N, your service to us cannot be overstated. You truly are a hero of this realm!

8231.name: Wavethrashing
desc: Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
objectives: Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
details: The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in Azshara. They are powerful and resilient.
BThe tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.
BTrack and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of Azshara, and bring me their scales.
completion: The wavethrashers are not easily defeated, even more so in their watery environment.
BYou have proven yourself ready to hunt even deadlier prey.

8255.name: Of Coursers We Know
desc: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
objectives: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
details: The mosshoof coursers of Azshara are magnificent animals who once lived in Felwood. They naturally resist disease and poison, and were unaffected by the corruption there. In their ancestral wisdom, they simply chose to leave that sickened place.
BIt saddens my heart, but I must ask you to hunt these mighty beasts for me. Gather four courser glands as the first ingredient for a restorative salve -- a salve we will use to heal Felwood.
completion: It is good the divine path has led you to us, $N. Your beliefs do not interfere with the tasks involved in creating this salve.
BYou see, the courser is sacred to the Cenarion Circle, and killing them for any reason, no matter how necessary, weakens their spirit.

8279.name: The Twilight Lexicon
desc: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
objectives: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
details: The Twilight's Hammer are not kind to those that leave their ranks. They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast! Needless to say, an enemy of theirs is a friend of mine!

BTo decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations! The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's Hammer camps.
completion: Yes! These are the parts to the book! Let's get started then, $N.
BSwap every third word with words from the second chapter... then swap every other word with words from the first chapter... Wait, did I get that backwards?

8303.name: Anachronos
desc: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
objectives: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
details: It is time, $N.
BI must apologize for keeping so much in secret. Enemies abound, even under our very noses. Please, read from this tome and learn. Take the knowledge I give to you and seek out our master.
completion: You are the hope of Kalimdor, $N.

8351.name: Bor Wishes to Speak
desc: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
details: Now that you can disguise yourself as a ruling member of the Twilight Council, I am certain Bor Wildmane will want to speak with you. Go see him, and prepare yourself for a very difficult mission...
completion: Yes, that's right, $N. I have a very tough task ahead...

8375.name: Remember Alterac Valley!
desc: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: Make no mistake about it, $N. The Horde is quite right when they say Alterac Valley is Frostwolf Territory.

BYou see, the Stormpike Expedition arrived as peaceful visitors to the area in search of ore and relics. The Frostwolves reacted with the most brutal and uncivilized act of aggression the Alliance has experienced.
BLet us never forget the brave dwarves that perished in that cowardly unannounced attack. Go now, $c, do your part in the battle for Alterac Valley. For the Alliance!
completion: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.

8399.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.
BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.
BDo your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, $N! For the Alliance!
completion: Good work, $N. Thanks to you, our natural defenses in Ashenvale will remain intact for another day.

8423.name: Warrior Kinship
desc: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
objectives: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
details: <The Hero looks you over.>
BYou are a $c, no doubt. I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.
BIt is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike. Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
completion: I need no proof to know what you have done, warrior. I can see the determination etched in your expression.

8447.name: Waking Legends
desc: Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
objectives: Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
details: The waters of Lake Elune'ara should dissolve the nightmares engulfing this object. Give me a moment to perform the cleansing, $N.
completion: Take his ring, $N. It has served its purpose for Malfurion. It shall now serve a new purpose for you...

8471.name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
desc: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
objectives: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
details: You have found one of the Winterfall furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but it seems to emanate an almost tangible sense of dread and despair. If many of the Winterfall furbolgs do indeed carry these, it certainly would go a long way in explaining their current condition.
BOne of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.
completion: This thing... it is in the shape of a Winterfall Ritual Totem, but it has been twisted by forces I cannot begin to comprehend. Whatever taint that has set the Winterfall against us is surely present in this object.
BDivine wisdom has brought both this and you to us, $N. We will study this object intently; perhaps one day, the Winterfall will rage against us no longer.
BThank you, friend please accept these offerings in exchange for your benevolence.

8495.name: The Alliance Needs More Iron Bars!

8519.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
desc: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
objectives: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.$B
details: As you regain your composure and focus your gaze, you notice that something stirs within the crystal. Upon closer inspection, you realize that you are looking into the past... a memory... long forgotten.
completion: After Staghelm's betrayal, I gathered the shattered pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and returned here. I had every intention of protecting the scepter from those that would seek to use it to cause harm to our world - thus was born the charge of the Dragonflights.

BA scepter divided amongst the four mighty Aspects would prove to be nearly impossible to restore for those willfully seeking chaos... or so I thought. What a fool I was. Even now I am hunted by that cursed flight.

8543.name: The Horde Needs More Tin Bars!

8591.name: The Horde Needs More Thick Leather!

8615.name: The Horde Needs Baked Salmon!
desc: Bring 20 Baked Salmon to Chief Sharpclaw at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Baked Salmon to Chief Sharpclaw at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: The Ahn'Qiraj war effort is an immense undertaking, $c. All of the materials being gathered here, whether it is metal for weapons, or food to eat, are all as important as the other. For, if you haven't eaten in days you will not have the strength to lift your axe when it matters.
BThus, we gather what food we can. I am collecting baked salmon, a dish that was chosen both for its sustenance and its ability to keep well. Can you aid me with this task, $c?
completion: Wonderful, $C! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! Thank you.
BI hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of Feralas is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.
BThank you again, $C.

8711.name: Blade of Eternal Justice
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
completion: You've done well, $C. This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.
BTake your weapon, $N. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

8735.name: The Nightmare's Corruption
desc: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each. Return to Keeper Remulos in the Moonglade when you have completed this task.
objectives: Travel to the four Emerald Dream portals in Azeroth and collect a Fragment of the Nightmare's Corruption from each. Return to Keeper Remulos in the Moonglade when you have completed this task.$B
details: You must travel to the four dream portals of Azeroth. From each you must draw a fragment of the Nightmare's corruption. The dragonkin that inhabit these areas will hold such fragments. Return to me when you have gathered these fragments.
completion: Are you prepared? Is the world prepared for what we are about to invoke? I do not know... I am bound by duty to Malfurion. Duty and honor...

8759.name: The Path of the Invoker

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the invoker!

8903.name: Dangerous Love
desc: Get a Stormwind Guard's Card and return it to Aristan Mottar in Stormwind.
objectives: Get a Stormwind Guard's Card and return it to Aristan Mottar in Stormwind.
details: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's not proper, it's an eyesore, and at worst, it could be a threat to the the safety of the Alliance itself.
BJust think: what if the guards have been taken in by this strange affliction? Something must be done.
BGo to one of the guards here in Stormwind and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
completion: So it is true. This is unbelievable. How could this have happened? Let me think for a moment. There must be a reason behind this.

8927.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.

8951.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

8999.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Deliana your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
objectives: Give Deliana your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
details: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
BI hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

9023.name: The Perfect Poison
desc: Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.
objectives: Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.
details: My brother and I run the poison operations out of the manor Ravenholdt.
BLord Ravenholdt tasked me to track down a new and extremely effective poison compound that can be crafted from the venom sacs of the inhabitants of Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

BThere are two particularly venomous beasts residing in those blasted ruins that possess what it is that we might be looking for, $c. Bring me a venom sac from the beasts Kurinnaxx and Venoxis and we would be eternally grateful.
completion: Ravenholdt thanks you, hero! Take your pick!

9239.name: Glacial Gloves
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 4 Essences of Water, 2 Ironweb Spider Silks and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 4 Essences of Water, 2 Ironweb Spider Silks and 200 gold.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Glacial gloves. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9263.name: Investigate the Scourge of Orgrimmar
desc: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Orgrimmar and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Orgrimmar and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
details: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Orgrimmar from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

objectives: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
details: You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.
The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.

objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the .
* Bundle of Hides (Barrens) (provided)
details: These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.
Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.

objectives: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
details: The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.
A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.

objectives: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
* Bloodtalon Matriarch Eggs
details: All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.

objectives: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
*Treaty of Understanding (provided)
details: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
